title.narrative: Sector Budget Support contract to support the Rule of Law in Jordan

description.narrative:
The Government of Jordan also has embarked upon large-scale Rule of Law (RoL) reforms, in order to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of justice services and judicial procedures, namely by increasing the independence of the Judiciary and operating an extensive digitalisation and automation of justice systems to improve workflow management and the exchange of information between justice sector institutions.

Under AAP 2021 based on the successful implementation of Phase I as well as the MoJ developed and presented an ambitious new Justice Sector Strategy 2022 ¿ 2026 the EU programmed a 39 MEUR action to support the justice and law enforcement agencies to implement the strategy.

The action builds upon the support provided by the EU to the Rule of Law (RoL) reform agenda. It seeks to maintain and support efforts already undertaken and progress achieved by the justice and law enforcement institutions to deliver effective, efficient, and accountable justice services and judicial procedures.
